groups.name: Wallstreet
groups.profile: Smaller/newer leak-site brand (added to Ransomware.live tracking 2026-06-26); no independent public profile yet.

groups.name: NightSpire
groups.profile: Emerged March 2025; claimed 250+ victims across retail, manufacturing, healthcare, finance and education in the US, France, India, Taiwan and Japan; aggressive double extortion with ransom deadlines as short as two days.

groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Active since July 2022 (Agenda lineage); Golang-based locker with multiple operator-controlled encryption modes; double extortion.

groups.name: Rhysida
groups.profile: RaaS that emerged May 2023; phishing + Cobalt Strike intrusion, appends '.ryshida' extension, threatens public release of exfiltrated data.

groups.name: Spirals
groups.profile: Very new leak-site brand (added to Ransomware.live tracking 2026-09-18); no independent public profile yet.

groups.name: The Gentlemen
groups.profile: RaaS that emerged Jul–Aug 2025 (aka Storm-2697); Go-based locker hitting Windows/Linux/NAS/BSD; 90% affiliate revenue share; claims 320+ victims across 17+ countries, with a leaked 2026 C2 server showing 1,570+ linked victims. 8 further claims against this group surfaced on Ransomware.live this window but were already published in Issues №39–41 (see Reposts below) — only 1 new hit counted here.
